summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md, as specified. Nothing was executed (tests, mypy, black not run) because the instructions barred running repository code; verification was by reading only. Deviations to review: the private reader adds mode and name properties (typing.BinaryIO declares them abstract, so the class would not instantiate otherwise); Progress.open and module-level open have a third overload accepting a plain str mode, needed for strict mypy; the 'tr' spelling is accepted and returns a binary reader, following the spec's exact-match rule; readinto returns the byte count; only the three suppressions the spec lists were added, and whether mypy needs exactly those depends on the bundled typeshed. No commit was made.
